T: Watch the girl. Eat the doughnuts.
D: Two Seattle cops on surveillance duty, and one falls for the woman they're watching.
P: Serve the snacks when Bill and Chris start their movie trivia game.
S: Warm cake doughnuts shaken in a bag of cinnamon sugar
Cake doughnuts warmed for 2 minutes, then shaken in a paper bag with cinnamon sugar until coated.
Pretzels, peanuts, cereal squares and seeds baked with Worcestershire butter

Pretzels, peanuts, cereal squares and sunflower seeds tossed in butter, Worcestershire and garlic powder, baked at 130C for 45 minutes. Toss 150g pretzels, 150g peanuts, 150g cereal squares and 50g sunflower seeds with 60g melted butter, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 1 tsp garlic powder. Bake at 130C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes. Cool before bagging up.

Hot-smoked salmon flaked onto rye crispbread with crème fraîche, pickled red onion, dill and a squeeze of lemon. Slice half a red onion very thin and cover with 3 tbsp white wine vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and a pinch of salt for 20 minutes. Break 16 rye crispbreads in half. Spread each with crème fraîche, top with a flake of hot-smoked salmon from 250g, a few pickled onion rings and a sprig of dill. Squeeze lemon over and crack black pepper on top.
M: Shredded chicken in corn tortillas under dried chili sauce and baked cheddar
Chicken enchiladas: shredded chicken in corn tortillas, red chilli sauce, cheese, baked at 190C for 20 minutes.

Cod fillets in a crisp lager batter, fried golden, with double-fried chips, lemon, malt vinegar and a chunky caper tartare sauce. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, soak 30 minutes, dry and fry at 140C for 6 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour and 50g cornflour with 300ml ice-cold lager and salt. Dust 700g cod fillets in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 4 to 5 minutes. Fry the chips again at 190C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g mayo with chopped capers, gherkins and dill. Serve with lemon and malt vinegar.
W: Yeast dough balls fried golden and served warm
Yeasted dough proved an hour, rolled into balls, fried at 175C for 2 minutes, rolled in cinnamon sugar while warm.
K: Hot coffee with brown sugar and Irish whiskey, floated with lightly whipped cream

Strong hot coffee with brown sugar and Irish whiskey poured into mugs, topped with lightly whipped cream floating on top. Brew 800ml strong coffee. Stir 4 tsp brown sugar and 160ml Irish whiskey into the hot coffee and pour into a warmed thermos if you're on the move. Lightly whip 150ml thickened cream until just thick but still pourable. Pour the coffee into 4 mugs and float the cream on top by pouring it over the back of a spoon.

steps.text: Warm the doughnuts on a tray at 160C.
Drop into a paper bag with the cinnamon sugar, fold the top and shake until coated.
Toss everything together with the butter, Worcestershire and garlic powder.
Bake at 130C, stirring every 15 minutes.
Cool before bagging up.
Soak the dried chillies in hot water.
Blitz with the tomatoes and garlic and simmer into a sauce.
Poach the chicken and shred it.
Roll the chicken in the tortillas and place in a dish.
Cover with sauce and cheddar and bake at 190C.
Serve with sour cream.
Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, egg and warm milk into a soft dough and knead briefly.
Cover and prove.
Roll into small balls.
Fry at 175C in batches until golden.
Roll in cinnamon sugar while warm.
Brew the coffee.
Stir the sugar and whiskey into the hot coffee.
Lightly whip the cream until thick but still pourable.
Pour the coffee into mugs and float the cream on top over the back of a spoon.

s.note: Warm cake doughnuts shaken in cinnamon sugar
s.how: Warm 8 cake doughnuts on a tray at 160C for 2 minutes. Drop them into a paper bag with 100g caster sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon, fold the top and shake until coated. Eat them out of the bag.

s.note: Pretzels, peanuts, cereal squares and sunflower seeds tossed in butter, Worcestershire and garlic powder, baked at 130C for 45 minutes.
s.how: Toss 150g pretzels, 150g peanuts, 150g cereal squares and 50g sunflower seeds with 60g melted butter, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 1 tsp garlic powder. Bake at 130C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes. Cool before bagging up.

m.note: Baked chicken enchiladas in red chilli sauce
m.how: Soak 4 dried chillies in hot water, blitz with 1 tin tomatoes and garlic and simmer 10 minutes. Poach and shred 600g chicken thighs. Roll in 8 corn tortillas, cover with sauce and 150g cheddar and bake at 190C for 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream.

w.note: Little yeasted doughnut balls rolled in cinnamon sugar
w.how: Mix 300g flour, 7g yeast, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 egg and 160ml warm milk into a soft dough and prove an hour. Roll into small balls and fry at 175C for 2 minutes. Roll in 100g caster sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon while warm.

d.note: Strong hot coffee with brown sugar and Irish whiskey poured into mugs, topped with lightly whipped cream floating on top.

Lightly whip 150ml thickened cream until just thick but still pourable. Pour the coffee into 4 mugs and float the cream on top by pouring it over the back of a spoon.
